verdict.rationale: Vercel documents running code before a request completes to rewrite, redirect, or personalize responses, which is request-path compute, and it serves optimized assets from its CDN. Fluid compute covers on-demand server-side code. None of this evidence explicitly says the code runs on a globally distributed edge network near end users, so the edge placement is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a global edge network and region distribution for user code, latency or proximity claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration of edge execution.
